_comment: Hardware firmware uses these blank-until-scanned RFID placeholders. The website is not connected to the ESP32.
notes: Scan tags with the firmware and copy printed UIDs into the two constants in hardware/SmartComponentsFinder/SmartComponentsFinder.ino.
RFID verification is disabled for standalone first demo; enable it only after both UIDs are configured and checked.
The 16 physical LED positions are configurable in the firmware parts table and are not synchronized with the website.
No live hardware communication or physical test is claimed.
